Evidence category: method. This card preserves the evidence layer's structured statements and their original field labels; it does not add a new literature review or certify benchmark scoring thresholds.
Text_Reference: Evidence-layer structured paraphrase; not a verbatim quotation. Source release: https://github.com/404NotFound422/TOCAgentProject/tree/5e3a711befb3952a2e39f4d53fc9c9f1a7ac0d22/KnowledgeBase/evidence_expansion_20261019

Application.Text1:
scientific_units:
unit_id: S01
sample_scope: fixed porcine gracilis and pectineus
stage: sample
statement: 12 approximately 2 cm edge blocks and 10 larger pieces 4–5 cm long and 2–3 cm wide; larger piece thickness not reported.
source_locator: Methods Tissue Preparation (a)
n: 22

Application.Text2:
scientific_units:
unit_id: S02
sample_scope: human donor auricle
stage: sample
statement: Five body donors; methods names cymba conchae while results/figure use earlobes. Figure 4 shows paired left control and right ultrasound ears 1–5; do not silently equate anatomical labels.
source_locator: Methods (b); Fig4A
n: 5

Application.Text3:
scientific_units:
unit_id: P01
sample_scope: porcine muscle
stage: fixation
statement: 4% formaldehyde overnight at 4°C; subsequent three PBS washes of 5 min each.
source_locator: Methods Tissue Preparation (a)
duration_scope: preclearing

Application.Text4:
scientific_units:
unit_id: P02
sample_scope: porcine muscle
stage: decolorization
statement: 2% hydrogen peroxide in PBS for 90 min.
source_locator: Methods Tissue Preparation (a)
duration_scope: stage

Application.Text5:
scientific_units:
unit_id: P03
sample_scope: porcine muscle
stage: dehydration
statement: DMP acid-catalysed dehydration; initial 3 h followed by fresh reagent overnight. Exact overnight duration not stated. Text describes 12 blocks and two larger pieces initially, although total large sample allocation later is ten.
source_locator: Methods Tissue Preparation (a)
duration_scope: stage
total_time: null (as recorded in source)

Application.Text6:
scientific_units:
unit_id: P04
sample_scope: human auricle
stage: pretreatment
statement: Author states same fixation/bleaching/dehydration framework in separate approximately 5mL vials. After 3 h paragraph says fresh acidified DBE rather than DMP; preserve literal reagent discrepancy, do not silently correct. One-hour DCM step reported after DMP dehydration.
source_locator: Methods Tissue Preparation (b)
reagent_conflict: true

Application.Text7:
scientific_units:
unit_id: P05
sample_scope: all reported fixed samples
stage: RI_matching
statement: DBE reported RI=1.562; peroxide/benzaldehyde removal by basic alumina filtration and anhydrous handling. Not a validated immunolabeling protocol.
source_locator: Methods Refractive Index Matching

Application.Text8:
scientific_units:
unit_id: P06
sample_scope: small porcine blocks
stage: RI_matching
statement: Six blocks allocated to 40kHz group and six to passive orbital-shaker control; group DBE volumes differ (200mL versus250mL).
source_locator: Methods RI Matching paragraph2
n_per_group: 6
confounding_conditions: 
  [1] DBE volume differs

Application.Text9:
scientific_units:
unit_id: P07
sample_scope: larger porcine pieces
stage: RI_matching
statement: Five per group, distributed over two bottles per group; 1–4h reported treatment depends on sample size; not full preparation duration.
source_locator: Methods RI Matching paragraph3
n_per_group: 5
duration_scope: RI_matching_only

Application.Text10:
scientific_units:
unit_id: P08
sample_scope: fixed specimens in acoustic comparison
stage: temperature_and_device
statement: 40kHz device maximum320W; 1MHz device operated300W; both approximately20°C by external cooling. Nominal generator power is not measured acoustic dose at specimen.
source_locator: Methods Ultrasound Generation
measured_acoustic_dose: null (as recorded in source)

Application.Text11:
scientific_units:
unit_id: R01
sample_scope: small porcine blocks
stage: transparency
statement: Fig3A photographs at0,30,60,90,120,150min show more rapid clearing with40kHz; caption calls near transparency at90min. Methods says photography every60min: retain interval discrepancy.
source_locator: Fig3A; Methods RI Matching
metric_kind: qualitative_photo
percentage: null (as recorded in source)

Application.Text12:
scientific_units:
unit_id: R02
sample_scope: larger porcine pieces
stage: transparency
statement: Fig3B compares control/ultrasound at1,2,3,4h and2days; ultrasound advantage visible by early timepoints. No universal total-time speedup computed.
source_locator: Fig3B
metric_kind: qualitative_photo

Application.Text13:
scientific_units:
unit_id: R03
sample_scope: porcine muscle in1MHz comparison
stage: morphology
statement: Visible cracks after1h, Fig2C. Authors report no such artifacts in40kHz group; do not extend to absence of molecular damage.
source_locator: Fig2C; Discussion
damage_frequency: null (as recorded in source)

Application.Text14:
scientific_units:
unit_id: R04
sample_scope: human paired ear samples
stage: long_term_transparency
statement: After one year DBE storage ultrasound group has higher visible-range transmission than control. This is storage follow-up, not treatment duration or fluorescent-protein retention.
source_locator: Fig4A/B; Results
duration_scope: storage
fluorescence_retention: null (as recorded in source)

Application.Text15:
scientific_units:
unit_id: R05
sample_scope: human ear samples
stage: spectroscopy
statement: Transmission spectra400–700nm in DBE-filled2cm path cuvette; Figure4B displays error bars but article does not define their statistic or spectroscopic replicate denominator. Do not invent SEM/n or exact curve values.
source_locator: Methods Spectroscopic Analysis; Fig4B
error_bar_definition: null (as recorded in source)
spectroscopic_n: null (as recorded in source)

Application.Text16:
scientific_units:
unit_id: R06
sample_scope: human auricle/ear biopsy
stage: imaging
statement: Three excitation autofluorescence channels488/532/640nm; Fig5A/B XY andXZ views show improved central-region visibility with ultrasound; scale bar1mm, not numerical imaging-depth threshold.
source_locator: Methods Light Sheet; Fig5
imaging_depth_um: null (as recorded in source)
label_mode: autofluorescence

Application.Text17:
scientific_units:
unit_id: L01
sample_scope: tested healthy fixed specimens
stage: applicability
statement: Immunolabeling compatibility not evaluated; no protein/nucleic-acid/lipid molecular preservation assays; diseased tissue/organoid applicability not validated here.
source_locator: Discussion limitations
claim_type: explicit_boundary

Application.Text18:
scientific_units:
unit_id: L02
sample_scope: 40kHz versus1MHz devices
stage: mechanism
statement: Stable cavitation/microstreaming explanation is author hypothesis; equal nominal power does not independently establish equal negative pressure, cavitation regime or measured MI.
source_locator: Discussion mechanism
evidence_type: author_hypothesis_not_direct_measurement

Application.Text19:
scientific_units:
unit_id: L03
sample_scope: all branches
stage: time
statement: Fixation, decolorization and dehydration precede1–4h RI matching; source has overnight and unresolved ear reagent transition, so no single numeric end-to-end time is asserted.
source_locator: Methods
whole_workflow_time: null (as recorded in source)
